title: hp-2: hotplug event queue + C_WaitForSlotEvent
description: Add pthread_cond_t/pthread_mutex_t hotplug notification infrastructure. Ring buffer for slot change events (slot_id + arrived flag). Implement C_WaitForSlotEvent: poll mode (CKF_DONT_BLOCK -> CKR_NO_EVENT) and blocking mode. Add wp11_test_inject_hotplug() hook for test-only mock injection (WOLFP11_CFG_TEST guard). Hotplug callback pushes to queue under g_hotplug_mutex, signals g_hotplug_cond — never holds g_lock during signal to avoid deadlock.
